name: karuta-youtube-hud
description: Chrome extension that overlays a rewind-to-just-before-the-reading HUD on YouTube for competitive karuta videos.

scripts.package: npm run build && find dist -name .DS_Store -delete && rm -rf dist/.vite && rm -f karuta-youtube-hud.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../karuta-youtube-hud.zip .
